Well this snuck up on everyone. Only 10 days on the forum!
Mixed feelings. I'm glad it's not a commendation and calls out so much failure

I also like Dave. But I don't think he warrants a C/C, and the weirdly accelerated timeline and failure stuff feels like an attempt to get around that. I think that if the authors thought there was any chance they could get away with a commendation instead, they would've written one

At the same time, it is a rare example of a condemnation actually feeling like a condemnation and not a reskinned gold done on the nominee's request. He's also been retired for years and won't get anything out of the badge
Condemn Davelands was passed 9,301 votes to 1,405 (86.9% support).
